units.source_text: 天气很热的时候，源氏在凉爽之处设一座位，独坐凝思。

en.t: When the weather was very hot, Genji had a seat set up in a cool place and sat alone, lost in thought.

units.source_text: 看见池塘中莲花盛开，首先想起“人身之泪何其多”的古歌，

en.t: Seeing lotus flowers blooming in profusion in the pond, he first recalled the old poem, "How many are the tears of human life,"

units.source_text: 便茫然若失，如醉如痴，一直坐到日暮。

en.t: and then, dazed and bereft, as if drunk or entranced, he sat there until dusk.

units.source_text: 鸣蜩四起，声音非常热闹。

en.t: Evening cicadas began calling all around, their voices rising in a lively clamor.

units.source_text: 瞿麦花映着夕阳，鲜美可爱。

en.t: The dianthus flowers glowed in the setting sun, bright and lovely.

units.source_text: 这般风光，一人独赏毕竟乏味。

en.t: Such scenery, after all, felt dull when enjoyed alone.
